text: Muang Thai Insurance's Form 56-1 One Report lists its top shareholders as at 30 December 2025: Muang Thai Group Holding Co., Ltd. (20.00%), Nualphan Lamsam (13.25%) and Ageas Insurance International N.V. (12.20%).
